laws.tp: Hours, rest, leave, written particulars and pay.
laws.s2: Mengatur jam kerja, istirahat, cuti, keterangan kerja tertulis, dan upah.

laws.k: domestic-workers|ZA|Mahlangu v Minister of Labour (Constitutional Court)
laws.t: Mahlangu v Minister of Labour (Constitutional Court)
laws.tp: Exclusion of domestic workers from work-injury compensation held unconstitutional.
laws.s2: Mahkamah Konstitusi memutuskan bahwa mengecualikan pekerja rumah tangga dari ganti rugi kecelakaan kerja bertentangan dengan konstitusi.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Basic Conditions of Employment Act and a sectoral determination for domestic work.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood

Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
coded.n: National minimum wage applies in full since 2022.

dec.n: Larbi-Odam and Others v. MEC for Education (North-West Province)
dec.pe: Teachers from other African countries were told they could not hold permanent jobs because they were not South African citizens. The Constitutional Court said this was unfair discrimination and opened the posts to permanent residents.
dec.pi: Guru-guru dari negara Afrika lain diberi tahu bahwa mereka tidak boleh menjadi guru tetap karena bukan warga Afrika Selatan. Mahkamah Konstitusi menyatakan ini diskriminasi yang tidak adil dan membuka jabatan itu bagi penduduk tetap.

dec.n: Dawood v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: Foreign spouses of South Africans were refused permits to stay while their residence applications were decided, with no rules for officials to follow. The Constitutional Court said this breached the right to family life.
dec.pi: Pasangan asing warga Afrika Selatan ditolak izin tinggal selama permohonan izin tetapnya diproses, tanpa aturan bagi petugas. MK menyatakan ini melanggar hak atas kehidupan keluarga.

dec.n: Mohamed v. President of the Republic of South Africa
dec.pe: A Tanzanian man was quickly sent from South Africa to the United States to stand trial for an embassy bombing. The Constitutional Court said this was unlawful without a promise that he would not be executed.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Tanzania segera dikirim dari Afrika Selatan ke Amerika Serikat untuk diadili atas pengeboman kedutaan. MK menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa janji ia tidak akan dihukum mati.

dec.n: Minister of Home Affairs v. Watchenuka
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
dec.pe: South Africa banned asylum seekers from working or studying while they waited, sometimes for years. The appeal court said a blanket ban breaks the right to dignity.
dec.pi: Afrika Selatan melarang pencari suaka bekerja atau belajar selama menunggu, kadang bertahun-tahun. Pengadilan banding menyatakan larangan menyeluruh melanggar hak atas martabat.

dec.n: Khosa v. Minister of Social Development
dec.pe: Mozambicans who were permanent residents in South Africa were denied pensions and child grants because they were not citizens. The Constitutional Court said they must be included.
dec.pi: Warga Mozambik yang menjadi penduduk tetap di Afrika Selatan ditolak pensiun dan tunjangan anak karena bukan warga negara. MK menyatakan mereka harus diikutsertakan.

dec.n: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs (detention at ports of entry)
dec.pe: People stopped at South African airports and harbours could be held without the protections other detainees have. The Constitutional Court said the same protections apply to them.
dec.pi: Orang yang dihentikan di bandara dan pelabuhan Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan tanpa perlindungan yang dimiliki tahanan lain. MK menyatakan perlindungan yang sama berlaku bagi mereka.

dec.n: Union of Refugee Women v. Director, Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority
dec.pe: Refugee women who wanted to work as security guards were refused because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court, by majority, let the rule stand.
dec.pi: Perempuan pengungsi yang ingin bekerja sebagai petugas keamanan ditolak karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK, dengan suara terbanyak, mempertahankan aturan itu.

dec.n: Discovery Health Ltd v. CCMA and Others
dec.pe: A foreign worker in South Africa was dismissed after his work permit ran out. The employer said he could not complain because he had no permit. The Labour Court said he was still an employee and could bring his case.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja asing di Afrika Selatan dipecat setelah izin kerjanya habis. Majikan berkata ia tidak bisa menggugat karena tidak punya izin. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan menyatakan ia tetap pekerja dan boleh mengajukan perkaranya.

dec.n: Bula v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
dec.pe: Ethiopian men held in a deportation centre said they wanted asylum. The appeal court said they must be released and allowed to apply.
dec.pi: Pria Etiopia yang ditahan di pusat deportasi menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. Pengadilan banding menyatakan mereka harus dibebaskan dan diizinkan mengajukan.

dec.n: Somali Association of South Africa v. Limpopo Department of Economic Development
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
dec.pe: Police closed hundreds of small shops run by Somali and Ethiopian traders in Limpopo. The court said refugees may get trading licences, and asylum seekers too when they have no other way to earn a living.
dec.pi: Polisi menutup ratusan toko kecil milik pedagang Somalia dan Etiopia di Limpopo. Pengadilan menyatakan pengungsi boleh mendapat izin dagang, begitu pula pencari suaka jika tidak punya cara lain mencari nafkah.

dec.n: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: People held for deportation in South Africa could be kept for weeks without seeing a judge. The Constitutional Court said they must appear before a court within 48 hours.
dec.pi: Orang yang ditahan untuk dideportasi di Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan berminggu-minggu tanpa bertemu hakim. MK menyatakan mereka harus dihadapkan ke pengadilan dalam 48 jam.

dec.n: Minister of Home Affairs v. Scalabrini Centre (Cape Town reception office)
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
dec.pe: The government stopped accepting new asylum applications in Cape Town, so people had to travel far to apply. The appeal court said the closure was unlawful and ordered the office to reopen.
dec.pi: Pemerintah berhenti menerima permohonan suaka baru di Cape Town sehingga orang harus bepergian jauh untuk mendaftar. Pengadilan banding menyatakan penutupan itu tidak sah dan memerintahkan kantor dibuka kembali.

dec.n: Saidi v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: Asylum seekers whose claims were refused lost their papers while they challenged the refusal in court, so they could be arrested or lose their jobs. The court said the papers must stay valid until the case ends.
dec.pi: Pencari suaka yang permohonannya ditolak kehilangan dokumen selama menggugat penolakan itu, sehingga bisa ditangkap atau kehilangan pekerjaan. Pengadilan menyatakan dokumen harus tetap berlaku sampai perkara selesai.

dec.n: Ruta v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: A Rwandan man arrested for being in South Africa without papers said he feared going home. The court said he must be allowed to claim asylum first, even though he had waited.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Rwanda yang ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen mengaku takut pulang. Pengadilan menyatakan ia harus diberi kesempatan mengajukan suaka dulu, meski sudah menunda.

dec.n: Nandutu v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: Foreign husbands and wives of South Africans had to leave the country to switch from a visitor visa to a spouse visa. The Constitutional Court said they may apply without leaving.
dec.pi: Suami atau istri asing warga Afrika Selatan harus keluar negeri untuk mengganti visa kunjungan menjadi visa pasangan. MK menyatakan mereka boleh mengajukan tanpa keluar.

dec.n: Mahlangu v. Minister of Labour
dec.pe: A domestic worker drowned in her employer’s pool and her family got nothing because the law left out domestic workers. The Constitutional Court said that was discrimination. The ruling covers many migrant domestic workers too.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga tenggelam di kolam renang majikan dan keluarganya tidak mendapat apa-apa karena UU tidak mencakup pekerja rumah tangga. MK menyatakan itu diskriminasi. Putusan ini juga melindungi banyak pekerja rumah tangga migran.

dec.n: Abore v. Minister of Home Affairs
dec.pe: An Ethiopian man was arrested for being in South Africa without papers and said he wanted asylum. The Constitutional Court said he must be released to apply.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Etiopia ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen dan menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. MK menyatakan ia harus dibebaskan untuk mengajukannya.

dec.n: Rafoneke v. Minister of Justice and Correctional Services
dec.pe: Law graduates from Lesotho and Zimbabwe who studied in South Africa could not be admitted as lawyers because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
dec.pi: Lulusan hukum dari Lesotho dan Zimbabwe yang belajar di Afrika Selatan tidak bisa diangkat sebagai pengacara karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

dec.n: Helen Suzman Foundation v. Minister of Home Affairs (Zimbabwean Exemption Permits)
dec.ct: High Court of South Africa, Gauteng Division
dec.pe: Many Zimbabweans had lived and worked in South Africa for over ten years on special permits. The government decided to end them. The High Court said this was unlawful without a fair process.
dec.pi: Banyak warga Zimbabwe tinggal dan bekerja di Afrika Selatan lebih dari sepuluh tahun dengan izin khusus. Pemerintah memutuskan mengakhirinya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa proses yang adil.

dec.n: Scalabrini Centre v. Minister of Home Affairs (abandonment rules)
dec.pe: A 2020 change in South Africa’s law said that asylum seekers who missed a renewal date had abandoned their claim and could be deported. The Constitutional Court struck this down.
dec.pi: Perubahan UU Afrika Selatan pada 2020 menyatakan pencari suaka yang terlambat memperpanjang izin dianggap meninggalkan permohonannya dan bisa dideportasi. MK membatalkannya.
